title: treemand command tree, version 1
description: The tree `treemand --output=json` and `--output=yaml` print: the root command, its flags and positional arguments, and its subcommands, recursively. Consumers should ignore properties they do not know; version 1 only ever gains optional properties.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Present on the root node only.

full_path.description: Every token from the root command to this one, e.g. ["git", "remote", "add"].

description.description: One-line summary from the help text.

flags.description: Options this command accepts, including inherited ones.

help_text.description: The raw help output the node was parsed from.

discovered.description: True when the command's help was run and parsed.

discovery_err.description: Why discovery of this command failed, e.g. a timeout. The rest of the tree is still valid.

stub.description: True for a subcommand that was listed but not discovered (too many siblings or beyond --depth).

virtual.description: True for a display-only group of flags that is not a command token.

name.description: The long form, e.g. "--verbose", or the only form the CLI offers.

value_type.description: The value the flag takes: "bool" for none, otherwise a type or placeholder such as "string", "int" or "FILE".

required.description: True when the help marks the flag as required.

inherited.description: True when an ancestor command defines the same flag (e.g. a global flag).

required.description: True when the argument must be given.

variadic.description: True when the argument accepts several values (e.g. "files...").
